reportedMessage: Accesso negato (HTTP 403). Il controllo di accesso ha negato la richiesta; sessione, scope e permessi devono essere verificati. Un nuovo login non concede permessi. Il lavoro è conservato; nessuna azione è stata inviata.

sourceFindings.finding: request() drops all arbitrary error text, accepts only allowlisted code/Code and bounded UUID correlationId; generic403 matches only status and absence of a recognized cause. It does not prove missing grant, scope, expired session or ownership.

Native page/script/API require same session and validated HUMAN JWT. Catch-all failure currently sends403; therefore generic403 may be session authentication or downstream authorization, not enough evidence to pick one.

Native GET api/{assetId}/{jobId} relays a server-held ouf-ths token to existing Gateway. Upstream4xx returned; successful response wraps card plusCSRF. User should share only error fields or safe card state, never csrfToken/token/full successful wrapper.
Card binds owner/tenant exact retained resource then requires file.profile. Writes additionally require quarantine.release and fresh expected state/review.
Versioned GET wildcard binding requires preview descriptor/OIDC/HUMAN; this source read does not prove current target route realization.

teatriReuse.reusedConclusion: Configured grant and OAuth scope/client/session are separate guards. Historical scope repair applied exact actual HUMAN client only after specific SCOPE_MISSING proof; old client/token/repair scopes must not be replayed.

nextRead.purpose: Inspect native error response which existing frontend intentionally hides, not retry an action or assume success
